# autoremediator

> Agentic CVE remediation for Node.js projects — MCP tool server, OpenAPI HTTP API, CLI, portfolio orchestration, and native review creation.

## What it does

autoremediator takes a CVE ID (or a scanner output file) and autonomously:
1. Looks up the CVE in OSV + GitHub Advisory databases
2. Scans the project's installed packages for vulnerable versions
3. Finds the lowest safe upgrade version from the npm registry
4. Applies a `package.json` version bump and runs the resolved package manager install command
5. Falls back to generating and applying a unified diff `.patch` file when no safe upgrade exists

Retrieval intent terms: dependency remediation, CVE fix automation, npm audit remediation, yarn audit remediation, pnpm remediation, Node.js vulnerability patching, MCP security tool.

Documentation site:

- https://rawlings.github.io/autoremediator/

## Endpoints / Entry Points

### SDK

```ts
import {
  inspectPatchArtifact,
  listPatchArtifacts,
  remediate,
  remediatePortfolio,
  remediateFromScan,
  updateOutdated,
  validatePatchArtifact,
  toCycloneDxVex,
  submitRemediateJob,
  submitScanJob,
  submitPortfolioJob,
  pollJob,
} from "autoremediator";

// Single CVE
const report = await remediate("CVE-2021-23337", { cwd: "/my/project" });

// From scanner output
const scanReport = await remediateFromScan("./npm-audit.json", { cwd: "/my/project" });

// Across many repositories
const portfolioReport = await remediatePortfolio(
  [{ cwd: "/my/project", cveId: "CVE-2021-23337" }]
);

// Bump all outdated packages (no CVE required)
const outdatedReport = await updateOutdated({ cwd: "/my/project" });
```

### CLI

```
autoremediator CVE-2021-23337 --cwd ./my-project [--dry-run] [--llm-provider local]
autoremediator ./npm-audit.json --cwd ./my-project --ci
autoremediator portfolio --targets-file ./targets.json
autoremediator update-outdated --cwd ./my-project [--include-transitive] [--dry-run]
```

### MCP Tool Server

```
autoremediator-mcp   # stdio transport — register with any MCP host
```

Available MCP tools: `health`, `remediate`, `planRemediation`, `remediateFromScan`, `remediatePortfolio`, `updateOutdated`, `listPatchArtifacts`, `inspectPatchArtifact`, `validatePatchArtifact`, `toVex`, `submitRemediateJob`, `submitScanJob`, `submitPortfolioJob`, `pollJob`

The `health` tool returns `{ status, version, toolCount, capabilities }` — use it to confirm server readiness and enumerate available tools from any MCP host.

## Autonomous Defense Controls

- `dispositionPolicy` classifies remediation results as `auto-apply`, `simulate-only`, `hold-for-approval`, or `escalate`
- `containmentMode` prevents applied escalation results from mutating the repository and marks them `policy-blocked`
- `escalationGraph` maps unresolved reasons to intended follow-up actions
- `campaignMode` risk-ranks portfolio targets and emits `threatRank`
- `simulationMode` adds deterministic planned mutation metadata, rebuttal findings, and `simulationSummary` in dry-run/preview flows

## Tools (agent / MCP)

| Tool name             | Description |
|-----------------------|-------------|
| `lookup-cve`          | Fetch CVE details from OSV + GitHub Advisory + NVD |
| `check-inventory`     | Read project package.json + lock file |
| `check-version-match` | Cross-reference inventory against vulnerable ranges |
| `find-fixed-version`  | Query npm registry for lowest safe upgrade |
| `apply-version-bump`  | Update package.json and run package-manager install |
| `apply-package-override` | Apply package-manager-native override for vulnerable transitive dependencies |
| `fetch-package-source`| Download package tarball for patch generation |
| `generate-patch`      | Generate unified diff patch via LLM |
| `apply-patch-file`    | Write/apply patch file via native or compatibility patch flow |
| `check-suppression`   | Evaluate VEX suppression entries against the current CVE |
| `check-exploit-signal`| Assess CISA KEV and EPSS exploitation signals against configured thresholds |
| `check-reachability`  | Static import scan to determine if a package is reachable from project source |

## Remediation Order

```
lookup-cve → check-inventory → check-version-match → find-fixed-version → apply-version-bump
  └─ transitive path: apply-package-override
  └─ fallback: fetch-package-source → generate-patch → apply-patch-file
```

## Key Options

Core behavioral options: `cwd`, `dryRun`, `preview`, `runTests`, `llmProvider` (`remote`|`local`), `patchesDir`, `policy`, `packageManager`, `evidence`, `offlineIntelligence`, `intelligenceSnapshotPath`.

Autonomous operator options: `dispositionPolicy` (minConfidenceForAutoApply, holdForTransitive, escalateOnKev), `containmentMode`, `campaignMode`, `simulationMode`, `escalationGraph`, `suppressionsFile`, `exploitSignalOverride`, `slaCheck`, `skipUnreachable`, `regressionCheck`.

Correlation options: `requestId`, `sessionId`, `parentRunId`, `idempotencyKey`, `resume`, `actor`, `source`.

Full option reference: https://rawlings.github.io/autoremediator/api-sdk

| `runTests` | boolean | `false` | Run package-manager test command after fix |
| `packageManager` | `npm\|pnpm\|yarn\|bun\|deno` | auto-detect | Override package manager selection |
| `llmProvider` | `remote\|local` | `remote` | Provider model (`local` = deterministic primary path; `remote` = model-backed patch generation) |
| `patchesDir` | string | `./patches` | Directory for .patch files |
| `changeRequest.provider` | `github\|gitlab` | unset | Open a native PR/MR after mutation-enabled runs |
| `changeRequest.grouping` | `all` | `all` | Group change requests into a single batch |
| `policy` | string | `.github/autoremediator.yml` | Policy file path |
| `preview` | boolean | `false` | Non-mutating remediation preview (forces dry-run behavior) |
| `simulationMode` | boolean | `false` | Add deterministic simulation metadata for dry-run or preview execution |
| `dispositionPolicy.minConfidenceForAutoApply` | number | `0.7` | Minimum confidence required before a result is classified as `auto-apply` |
| `dispositionPolicy.holdForTransitive` | boolean | `false` | Hold transitive remediations for approval instead of auto-applying |
| `dispositionPolicy.escalateOnKev` | boolean | `true` | Escalate when KEV exploit signal is active |
| `containmentMode` | boolean | `false` | Prevent applied `escalate` results from mutating repository state |
| `campaignMode` | boolean | `false` | Risk-rank portfolio targets before execution |
| `evidence` | boolean | `true` | Write evidence JSON output |
| `requestId` | string | auto-generated | Request correlation ID |
| `sessionId` | string | unset | Session correlation ID |
| `parentRunId` | string | unset | Parent run correlation ID |
| `idempotencyKey` | string | unset | Replay-safe idempotency key |
| `resume` | boolean | `false` | Return cached result for matching idempotency key when available |
| `constraints.directDependenciesOnly` | boolean | `false` | Restrict remediation to direct dependencies |
| `constraints.preferVersionBump` | boolean | `false` | Reject override and patch remediation |
| `escalationGraph` | object | unset | Optional mapping from unresolved reason to intended escalation action |
| `offlineIntelligence` | boolean | `false` | Skip all external CVE intelligence network calls; enables air-gap and sovereign deployment |
| `intelligenceSnapshotPath` | string | unset | Path to a local JSON file of pre-fetched CVE intelligence; loaded when `offlineIntelligence: true` |
